patch_list: Unlocks Daylio's local premium state. Account- or server-dependent features (restore purchase, cloud entitlements) still behave as they do on a free account; this is not a purchase.
Google Drive backup via MicroG RE

Makes the Google Drive backup sign-in work on a re-signed Daylio by signing in as the original app, and stops the "won't run without Google Play services" dialog. Needs MicroG RE installed with a Google account added. Daylio's local journa…

Removes Daylio's built-in advertising: the BetterHelp partner offer, the cross-promotion cards for the developer's other apps, and the "More Great Apps" row that opens a screen of their app catalogue. Daylio has no ad network; the journal,…
Daylio ships no ad SDK - this build has none to block. It does ship Firebase Analytics, Tag Manager, Crashlytics and the advertising-ID permissions; this turns those off. Every part is switchable.
